title: Scope guard (no demo CTA on /tools/*, /resources, rent-post) has no negative test
detail: Spec acceptance requires absence on /tools/*, /resources, /resources/:slug; the only testid assertions are presence checks on guide renders, so a future guide_demo_cta call added to another view ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a negative test rendering one /tools page, /resources, and a rent-post page, asserting string.contains("guide-demo-cta") is false for each.

title: "Directly under the signup CTA" placement and secondary-weight classes are unasserted
detail: The test pins presence only; nothing asserts the demo card renders after the signup CTA. A composition-list reorder keeping the call present leaves the suite green while breaking the documented placement.
recommended_fix: Per page, assert the guide-demo-cta index exceeds the primary CTA's index (match cta_base's "bg-amber" fragment), pinning the under-the-primary ordering.

title: Issue's verbatim copy block (heading, subline, button label) is asserted nowhere
evidence:
[html.text("See it work before you sign up")],
            "A live sandbox with a mock vacancy and ranked applications. No signup.",
          [html.text("Try the demo")],
detail: The issue mandates this copy exactly; only the testid and href are pinned, so editing the heading, subline, or label ships without any test failing. Low risk: single shared source function.
recommended_fix: Extend guide_demo_cta_present_on_every_guide_test with string.contains pins for the heading, the subline, and the "Try the demo" label.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
pub fn guide_demo_cta_present_on_every_guide_test() {
  [
    render_rtb_registration(),
    render_notice_periods(),
    render_letting_agent_costs(),
    render_tenant_vetting_checklist(),
    render_rent_increase_notice(),
    render_rtb_disputes(),
    render_property_management_fees(),
    render_tenancy_agreement_template(),
    render_landlord_reference_letter(),
    render_rental_income_tax(rental_income_tax_view.Empty),
    render_part_4_tenancy(),
  ]
  |> list.each(fn(html) {
    html |> string.contains("data-testid=\"guide-demo-cta\"") |> should.be_true
    html |> string.contains("href=\"/demo\"") |> should.be_true
  })
}
detail: P0 100%: all 11 guide views pinned (testid + href, per-view mutation-kill; registry, handler wiring, and helper signatures statically verified). No P1 gaps. P2 placement/scope-negative and P3 copy/mobile unpinned: overall ~75%. Suite not executable here (unrelated merge conflicts outside the diff).
recommended_fix: Add the ordering assert (demo CTA after primary CTA), a negative scope assert (tools/resources/rent-post), and three copy contains-pins to raise the gate to PASS.
